wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/move_constant_tables.py: """Moves the php int-constant tables into the one crate the compiler and eval() share.

MEASURED: `eval('echo SEEK_SET;')` is a runtime fatal while php prints 0, and so are 148 other
names the compiler declares — the whole `E_*` family, `FILE_APPEND`, and 95 `STREAM_*` constants
among them. The eval interpreter resolves constants through a hand-written match that simply does
not have them, and it cannot read the compiler's tables: `elephc-magician` does not depend on
`elephc`. The only place both can see is `elephc-builtin-contract`.

Only the `&[(&str, i64)]` tables move. Every call site keep
